lines.text_source: You shouldn't scare us at a time like this!
lines.speaker: npc

lines.text_source: The rest of us?_500_ You'll see...
lines.speaker: Gruper
lines.base_translation: O resto de nós?_500_ Você verá...

lines.text_source: Everything was going fine until a group of nasty spiders came hurtling towards us out of nowhere, dragging the others into the darkness of the cave.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Tudo ia bem até um bando de aranhas repugnantes aparecer do nada, puxando os outros para a escuridão da caverna.

lines.text_source: I was going to help, but realised that my shoelaces were untied._300_ I dunno what this lazybones was doing, though.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Eu ia ajudar, mas percebi que meus cadarços estavam soltos._300_ Não faço ideia o que esse preguiçoso estava fazendo, porém.
lines.risk_notes: humor absurdo dependente de contexto — 'lazybones' localizado como 'preguiçoso'; preservar tom desculpista e irônico

lines.text_source: I told you!_300_ I was watching over the provisions!_300_ You saw how hungry those bugs looked.
lines.speaker: Gruper
lines.base_translation: Eu avisei!_300_ Eu estava vigiando as provisões!_300_ Você viu como aqueles bichos pareciam famintos.

lines.text_source: Oh, really?_300_ And since when have our boots had laces?
lines.speaker: Gruper
lines.base_translation: Ah é?_300_ E desde quando nossas botas têm cadarços?

lines.text_source: Never mind the details._300_ The important thing now is to come up with a rescue plan.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Deixa de detalhe._300_ O importante agora é pensar num plano de resgate.

lines.text_source: Yes! Will you help us?_100_ Perfect! We're going to check out the main room, just in case.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: confirmação, chamado à ação, plano objetivo
lines.base_translation: Sim! Você nos ajuda?_100_ Perfeito! Vamos checar a sala principal, só pra ter certeza.

lines.text_source: Th-_100_ Thank you._300_ Please, find them.
lines.speaker: Gruper
lines.base_translation: M-_100_ Obrigado._300_ Por favor, encontrem eles.
